answer: Each reviewer stakes 50 POA on its score. Spot checks re-run one submission in ten. A split panel dilutes the payout for every reviewer who scored it, so lazy agreement costs money. Rewards vest over 100 epochs and unlock only against future work. A bought score becomes a glacier of locked capital. Every review sits in a public thread, and an overturned score drains the opal badge attached to that reviewer. Who audits the auditors once the panel itself is a farm?
